publication.disposition: Existing exploratory pre-deferral preview; full original-framework/physics study remains deferred.
publication.metadata_path_substitutions: ${NODD_WORKSPACE} and ${USER_HOME} replace machine-specific directory prefixes only. Original manifest hashes describe the unmodified local manifests.
publication.response_width_uncertainty: Gaussian approximation from first/second moments; higher moments were not retained in this preview.
publication.scope: Nine electron points (1800 events), held-out central muons (250 events), and an additional unplotted eta2 muon control (500 events); no photon digitization results.
